errors.evidence: The labeled y-axis shows a range from 0.0 to 0.6. While the plot area extends beyond 0.6, stating the range goes to 0.8 is an inaccurate overestimation of the axis scale shown.

errors.text_span: the error bars are smallest around rank 64
errors.evidence: The error bar at rank 16 is visually of a similar or slightly smaller size compared to the one at rank 64. It is incorrect to single out rank 64 as having the smallest error bars.
The lower bound of the error bar for rank 256 is visibly below the 0.3 grid line, at approximately 0.28. Describing this as 'from the mid-0.3s' (which implies a value around 0.35) is incorrect.
